shared_elements: repeated similar motifs aligned in a row
small schematic human-like figure (arguably in B only)
justification: Both surfaces present small, highly schematic figures repeated and roughly aligned in horizontal rows, and both include quadruped-like creatures, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A is organised into strict registers of animal bodies in profile with no vessels or human actors, while B is dominated by crescent-hulled boats with comb-like crew strokes, cupmark dots, dotted lines and armed human figures — motifs entirely absent from A.
